name: Gouvernement de la République Algérienne Démocratique et Populaire
notes: National executive of Algeria (Presidency of the Republic, Prime Minister's Office, and Ministry of Finance).

name: Assemblée Populaire Nationale
notes: 407 seats. apn.dz does not answer from outside Algeria, so this chart shows only the members Wikidata records for the Assembly elected in 2026, a small part of the seats; the rest show as 'Not named', which is not the same as vacant. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.

name: Conseil de la Nation
notes: 174 seats: two thirds elected by local councillors, one third appointed by the President (the 'presidential third'). Who sits and their party are from the Council's own list of current members (majliselouma.dz), which names about 150; the rest show as Vacant. Unlit seats mean nothing found, never opposition.
